messages: Michelle H: Quick sync — QA flagged a weird layout on mobile for the Console dashboards. Screens show table rows wrapping into tiny columns and the left nav sometimes covers table content when you scroll. Has anyone seen this on iPhone 12 / Safari? Alex W: repro'ed on iPhone 12 (Safari) and Pixel 4 (Chrome). Steps: open /console/projects -> switch to Projects tab -> tap a project with many model versions -> the versions table pushes beyond viewport and horizontal scroll isn't obvious. Sidebar overlap happens when you collapse then expand quickly. Priya R: thanks. UX notes: we currently hide the hamburger until <768px, but the sidebar has absolute positioning which causes overlap when the table gets a long single-row cell (eg. long model name + tags). Two quick options: 1) allow the table to horizontal-scroll with a visible thin scrollbar and a hint ("swipe to view") or 2) let the sidebar push the content (i.e., transform the container) and use a responsive drawer pattern. Preference lean: visible horizontal scroll for data tables, drawer for nav. Eric Z: engineering constraints: 1) making the sidebar push content requires refactor of grid container and breaks a bunch of z-index assumptions we use for toast/menus. 2) horizontal scroll is easier but we need to handle keyboard focus traps for accessibility. Also performance note — on lower-end devices the animated transform for drawer introduces noticeable jank. Design Bot: Accessibility scan: table overflow triggers low-contrast cutoffs and small interactive targets. Missing aria-label on sidebar toggle -> flagged. Michelle H: Priya — could you mock both options? We want to see which gives better discoverability for the horizontal scroll vs drawer. Also please add copy for the scroll hint (short). Priya R: will mock. Proposed copy for the hint: "Swipe left to view full table" with a chevron icon. For the drawer toggle aria: . Alex W: for keyboard/trackpad users on desktop we should keep the same pattern (visible scroll) at 768-992 breakpoint and only enable drawer <768. Otherwise desktop/tablet feels inconsistent. Eric Z: +1 to breakpoint idea. Implementation plan: CSS breakpoints at 992px and 768px. Behavior: >=992: full sidebar, table flexes and wraps minimally; 768-991: sidebar collapsible but still part of layout (compact), allow horizontal scroll on tables; <768: drawer (position fixed, slides over content). Michelle H: can we also ensure table cells don't force super long single-line overflow? Maybe use ellipsis + tooltip on tap to reveal full name. Priya R: yes — truncate with ellipsis and on mobile tap open a small inline popover with the full text and actions. For accessibility, the popover will be focusable and closable with Escape. Design Bot: Suggestion: add an offscreen text for the scroll hint for screen readers: Swipe horizontally to view the full table. Alex W: dev question — how do we detect "many columns" vs just long content? We could toggle the visible scrollbar only when table scrollWidth > clientWidth. JS snippet: ``` const table = document.querySelector('.data-table'); if (table.scrollWidth > table.clientWidth) { table.classList.add('showscroll'); } ``` But avoid layout thrash by running on resize with debounce. Eric Z: good snippet. Also add aria-live announcement when horizontal scroll appears? Might be noisy. Maybe only have sr-only instruction that is present whenever scroll exists. Michelle H: timeline? We need a small QA pass before next week's demo. Priya can you deliver mocks by EOD tomorrow? Engineering can spike on the scrollbar behavior and ARIA changes. Priya R: yes, mock & interaction spec by EOD tomorrow. I'll include both patterns and indicate recommended breakpoints. Alex W: I'll prototype the scroll detection + truncation tooltip. Plan to push a branch by Tuesday. Eric Z: I'll review perf impact; if drawer animation jank is bad we can fallback to non-animated show/hide for <768. Michelle H: thanks team. I'll add a quick note to the release checklist to include mobile console smoke test. :thumbsup: Design Bot: Automated note: Created ticket #CON-4853 for responsive console tweaks (breakpoints, table overflow, sidebar drawer).
